description: This file defines the ConfigStructure class, which models a data structure for configuration, providing mechanisms to add fields, handle alignments, and generate C headers, TunerStudio, and Java field representations for configuration structures.

classes.name: ConfigStructure
classes.description: Represents a configurable data structure with methods for adding fields, managing offsets and sizes, and generating code representations in C, Java, and TunerStudio formats.

methods.name: addAlignmentFill
methods.description: Handles alignment for the structure by adding fill fields to achieve 4-byte alignment.

methods.name: headerWrite
methods.description: Generates a C header struct definition for the configuration structure.

methods.name: writeJavaFields
methods.description: Generates Java field declarations corresponding to the structure.

methods.name: addBoth
methods.description: Adds a configuration field to both C and TypeScript field lists.

methods.name: addC
methods.description: Adds a field to the C-specific list.

methods.name: addTs
methods.description: Adds a field to the TypeScript-specific list.
